reason: Newer/current NVIDIA NeMo-Speech.cpp primary documentation narrows the local Q8 runtime interpretation for Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 and is material to Frankenstein realtime turn-taking.

source_observations.observation: The current feature matrix marks Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 as supporting 25 languages but not word boosting, VAD masking, endpointing, or language metadata in NeMo-Speech.cpp.
The endpointing section states that endpointing works with buffered CTC and cache-aware RNNT and explicitly describes Parakeet TDT as offline-only for streaming endpointing.

The official model card added a NeMo Python chunked-streaming example using 2 s chunks, 2 s right context and 10 s left context. This is a separate runtime path and does not establish NeMo-Speech.cpp Q8 incremental endpointing.
The official Q8_0 GGUF remains a valid pinned local artifact at 713975456 bytes with SHA-256 e3880d0aaaaf2c308ea2c35016b2b895c423eb3fda924c1b463d1c19b7f4d32e.

reconciliation.previous_boundary_preserved: The original result already said the NeMo-Speech.cpp Q8 path was not proven incremental/streaming.
reconciliation.new_stronger_boundary: Current official NeMo-Speech.cpp evidence now positively establishes that Parakeet TDT lacks its built-in streaming endpointing path there. Therefore the Q8 route must not be promoted as the direct realtime/EOU ASR organ for Frankenstein on source evidence alone.
reconciliation.remaining_valid_credit: Parakeet TDT remains source-eligible as a German accuracy/compactness/final-transcript challenger and as a possible externally endpointed pipeline component.
reconciliation.architecture_implication: INFERENCE: a Frankenstein pipeline could still use an external VAD/turn controller to close an utterance and then invoke Parakeet TDT, but that is not model-native streaming endpointing and must be benchmarked for end-to-end latency, partial transcript behavior and barge-in semantics.
reconciliation.priority_delta: For the native continuously streaming local-ASR frontier, prefer cache-aware RNNT/Nemotron-class candidates over Parakeet TDT until target evidence overturns this source-level limitation. Keep Parakeet as an accuracy/resource Pareto baseline rather than discard it.

counterhypothesis: The lack of NeMo-Speech.cpp endpointing may not matter if an external turn controller plus fast Parakeet final decoding produces equal or better German conversational latency/accuracy on the actual hardware.
falsifier: On clay-direct-dev, compare the exact pinned Parakeet Q8 path behind the same external VAD/turn controller against the admitted cache-aware streaming ASR candidates on identical German room audio; measure endpoint-to-final latency, partial/final stability where available, WER/CER, resource use and cancellation semantics.
execution_note: Do not create another target-runtime dispatch while the shared self-hosted runner assignment/availability gate has unresolved queued jobs. Consume existing target jobs after runner lifecycle recovery.
